summary: The audit checks 45 units of ARTHIST or FILMEDIA courses numbered 300 and above, taken at Stanford. You check by hand the reading knowledge of a foreign language, the extended paper approved by a faculty member, and the distribution knowledge shown to the faculty.

TlW00ycR.why: "Complete at least 45 units of graduate work at Stanford in Art History (ARTHIST) and/or Film & Media Studies (FILMEDIA) courses at the 300-level and above."

khFZiJZh.why: "Reading knowledge of at least one foreign language relevant to the student’s area of focus. The final determination of which foreign languages fulfill the requirement is made in consultation with the student’s primary advisor." Not met by moving a course in.

m2jfKJVm.why: "Submission of one extended paper (approx. 30 pages ...) ... approved by, a department faculty member."

YpHKkLio.why: "Demonstration to the faculty, by coursework and/or examination, that the student has adequate knowledge of the significant areas of the history of art and/or film & media studies"
